note: 6 Nov 2026 - 'Kevin Takes Calls With Special Guest Gary Spivey | The Kevin Trudeau Show | Ep. 25' (Rumble v53wjvq). Awakened Rise weekly agent, second pass. The first pass (AR_THRESHOLD) cut the medium/clairvoyant/psychic definitions, psychic gifts being trainable, and the Shaktipat awakening story - most of the rest is call-ins, photo tours, booking pitches, and a race/gender exchange skipped as too charged for her voice. Two clean new teachings survive without re-using any of the first pass's minutes: Gary's demons-and-angels description of clearing trauma, and the Baba Nityananda non-attachment story.

clips.send: A friend who swears something dark is 'attached' to them or someone they know, because this says a psychic sees it too - and that there's something to actually do about it. Fear, and strange comfort.
clips.caption:
"Demons exist," Gary Spivey says flatly, mid-reading, like it's the most normal sentence in the world. Not a metaphor, not a personality quirk - an actual dark energy he says he can see clinging to a person.

He says old trauma is what keeps the angels from getting close - there's a wall of dark energy in the way until it's cleared. So he clears it, tells the person exactly when it happened, and then, he says, it's gone permanently.

No ritual, no candles. Just a thing he claims he can see, and a thing he claims he can remove.

Comment RISE and I'll send you more of what he says he sees.

clips.send: A friend deep into 'high vibration' spiritual content who swears by minimalism and detachment, because this takes it to its most extreme, funniest real example - amusement and a little awe.
clips.caption:
Gary Spivey didn't bring up Baba Nityananda to inspire anyone. He brought him up to make a point: a master so anchored above the material world that he reportedly forgot to bathe.

He wasn't living "on planet earth" the way most people mean that, Gary says - and that's exactly why hygiene stopped registering. Enlightenment doesn't always look graceful.

The actual teaching underneath the joke: you don't have to give any of this up. Keep the house, the car, the nice things - as long as you're experiencing them instead of attached to them. That's the real difference between rich and free.

Comment RISE and I'll send you more on what that means.

#nonattachment #enlightenment #subconscious #awakening #guru #kevintrudeau
